Daily Devotional

March 27

3 Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father; (1 Thessalonians 1:3 KJV)

Patience and hope are related (Romans 8:24). These virtues that are in this verse are not just theological concepts, but they are seen in the everyday life of true believers. Faith is a matter of the heart, but it is seen through the outward works of love. When a person believes God, then his faith will be shown in his works of faith, as faith without works is dead (James 2:17), and is the only outward sign that he has faith in his heart, as the fruit of faith is obedience. These works are not “works of the law” (Philippians 3:9), but they are works of love to serve a God he loves. Works of the law are not of faith (Galatians 3:12).

The labor of love is not just love, but labor. We should show our love by our actions, or labor, not just in words (1 John 3:18). Patience of hope in our Lord, is necessary for a victorious life here on earth, as we need the patience and hope (faith over time), to stay true to our Lord, and keep serving Him in all we do. Praise God for His patience, and giving us patience in the fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23). Thank you Lord!
